_readme: Curated metadata for the component manifest generator. Add figmaNodeId values (strings) as Figma node IDs become available. Variant descriptions and tags override the group-level fallbacks. Run with --update-meta to add stubs for any registry entries not yet listed here.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Brand icons from Simple Icons and dynamic Lucide icons, both rendered as inline SVG via a name prop.

BrandIcon.title: Brand Icon
BrandIcon.description: Renders any Simple Icons brand logo by lowercase slug (e.g. "github", "stripe"). Defaults to the official brand hex colour.

DynamicIcon.title: Dynamic Icon
DynamicIcon.description: Renders any Lucide icon by PascalCase name (e.g. "Settings", "ChevronDown"). Forwards size and strokeWidth props.

otp-input.title: OTP Input
otp-input.description: One-time password input with individual digit boxes and auto-advance behaviour.

OtpInput.title: OTP Input
